title: Helix-Codex (Helix-Prime) — nine production gates
purpose: Each gate needs <gate>.evidence.json + .sig stored OUTSIDE the repo, scope production, signed with a key the audited system does not hold.

files.what_it_proves: A cryptographically signed evidence pack produced by an off-system key.
files.operator_note: Createlee produces the 8-file pack. The SIGNATURE must come from a key the audited system does not hold. Declare the public key to the release gate.

files.what_it_proves: Independent certification of tenant/data isolation at production scale.
files.operator_note: Requires a certification body your organisation appoints. No CSV closes this.

files.what_it_proves: Third-party audit of the control plane and audit chain.
files.operator_note: Requires an external auditor. No CSV closes this.

files.what_it_proves: Approved production deployment topology and review sign-off.
files.operator_note: Requires an architecture review by your infrastructure owner.

files.what_it_proves: Validated DR / backup plan exercised against the production environment.
files.operator_note: Requires a real DR test in production. No CSV closes this.

files.what_it_proves: Named production operations owner and rotation.
files.operator_note: Createlee supplies role_spec.csv with exactly one named_accountable=yes; the client fills the name and signs.

files.what_it_proves: Named production on-call and escalation contract.
files.operator_note: Createlee supplies incident_notifications.csv with named owners.

files.what_it_proves: Completed independent security review / penetration test.
files.operator_note: Requires a signed security review. No CSV closes this.

files.what_it_proves: Legal and data-privacy review for the production jurisdiction.
files.operator_note: Requires legal sign-off. No CSV closes this.
Keep exactly ONE row with named_accountable=yes.
Owner is never blank; SLA misses stay as honest findings.

cannot_generate: certified_data_isolation — needs an appointed certification body
disaster_recovery_evidence — needs a real production DR test
security_review — needs a signed independent security review
honesty: Simulated, format-exact template data. The client must replace ONLY the data rows with their own real rows and keep the header, column order and value conventions unchanged. Passing a validator does not make simulated data real compliance evidence.
